scale.semantics: Relative investigative priority. NOT a probability of guilt, NOT a creditworthiness measure, and NOT an enforcement trigger.

fusion.description: Each component is normalised to 0..1, multiplied by its weight, summed, then rescaled to 0..100. Weights of available components are renormalised so that a missing component lowers confidence rather than silently scoring the account as low risk.

rules.rationale: Rules are the explainable backbone. An analyst can always read why a rule fired, so they carry the largest single weight.

model.source: trained supervised model probability, when a validated model is active
model.rationale: Weighted below rules because the model is trained on synthetic labels and must not dominate an explainable decision.

anomaly.rationale: Unsupervised signal that catches typologies no rule encodes yet.

graph.rationale: Network position is strong evidence but partly already represented in the rule layer.

complaint.rationale: Deliberately modest in fusion because the complaint rules already escalate directly; double counting would let one allegation dominate the score.

notes: If the model is unavailable, the remaining weights are renormalised and scoring_mode becomes HEURISTIC_FALLBACK or RULES_ONLY.
A component that is merely zero is different from a component that is unavailable; only the latter is renormalised away.
Every assessment records which components were available in components_json.

bands.description: Band cut-points on the 0..100 scale. Chosen so that a single critical typology lands in HIGH, and CRITICAL requires genuinely corroborating evidence.

thresholds.action: No queue placement. Visible in search and account views only.
Appears in the triage queue at normal priority.
Alert raised. Prioritised in the triage queue.
Alert raised at top priority and surfaced in the dashboard escalation panel.

notes: An escalate_to_human rule effect raises an alert regardless of the fused score, so a complaint-named suspect is never missed because other signals were quiet.
Alerts are investigative leads. Raising one must never trigger an automatic account action.
Every indicator must carry evidence references that resolve to real persisted records.
An indicator with no resolvable evidence is dropped rather than shown unsupported.

prohibited_uses: Automatic account freezing, blocking, debit-blocking, or closure.
Adverse action against a customer without human investigation and a recorded disposition.
Any representation of the score as a probability of criminal guilt.
Use as a credit, employment, insurance, or eligibility signal.
Reporting a score to a third party without the accompanying limitations text.
caveats: Scores are computed from synthetic data in this prototype and are not calibrated against real-world fraud base rates.
A high score means 'look at this sooner', not 'this is fraud'.
A low score is not a clearance: novel typologies may not be represented in the rule set or the training data.
Component weights are a product decision, not a learned optimum, and should be re-tuned against real labelled outcomes before any production use.
